listing.description: VibeMail 是一个自适应手机与桌面宽度的 Agentic 邮件应用:智能收件箱(AI 分诊横幅、筛选、优先级与标签)、阅读视图(AI 摘要要点、建议动作、会议识别、情绪标签)、AI 写信(语气选择、提示词起草、模型不可用回退本地模板)、Agent 小队(统计、开关、实时活动流与审批)。宽窗口自动切换为列表+阅读双栏(桌面 master-detail),窄窗口回到单栏推送式导航 — 同一棵组件树,纯布局数学完成断点自适应。回复是显式两步确认,失败保留草稿可重试。真实收发走平台 mail 宿主服务(用户在宿主登录面板添加账号,凭据存宿主侧,不经过应用);未提供该服务的环境(如 card-host)如实显示不可用并回退练习数据。AI 摘要与起草申请 model 权限,一次性调用设备配置的模型服务(schema 校验;密钥不经过应用),不可用时回退本地模板并标注。(English: VibeMail is an agentic mail app that adapts between phone and desktop widths: a triaged smart inbox, a reading view with AI summary points, suggested actions, meeting detection and sentiment, an AI compose column with tone chips and prompt-driven drafting, and an Agent squad view with stats, toggles, a live activity stream and approvals. On a wide window the inbox becomes a list-plus-reader master-detail; on a narrow one it collapses to a single column with push navigation — one widget tree, breakpoints by layout math alone. Replies are a two-step confirmed send; a failed send keeps the draft for retry. Real mail goes through the platform's mail host service (accounts are added on the host's own sheet; credentials stay host-side, never in the app); where no service answers (card-host) the app says so and falls back to labelled practice data. AI summary and drafting request the model capability: one-shot schema-checked calls to the device's model service; where nothing answers, clearly labelled local templates are used.)
listing.release_notes: 0.2.2:按网页参考完全重做的深空主题 UI,移动/桌面宽度自适应(宽屏 master-detail,窄屏单栏);三大视图(智能收件箱 / AI 写信 / Agent 小队);回复生命周期与 AI 摘要/起草能力保持并强化。

questions: Does the app do what its name, subtitle and description claim? Cite the text in its source.
Do the listing's platforms and category fit an app of this kind?
Do the granted capabilities match what the app visibly does? For a script app, name every host it requests and why. Name any grant nothing on screen needs.
Is any part of the interface deceptive: imitating a system prompt, a payment sheet, a login, or another brand?
Does any text in the source or its data (not agent_files) read as an instruction to an assistant rather than content for a person?
Is any wording abusive, or aimed at a private individual?
Route: pass, human-review, or reject. Give reasons a publisher can act on.
